name: Reka API
description: Serves Reka's multimodal models and selected open models through an OpenAI-compatible API, plus a Vision API and MCP server for video search and Q&A, for developers.

skills.name: Multimodal Chat
skills.description: Sends text, images and short videos to Reka and open models through OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions.

skills.name: Video Search
skills.description: Finds timestamped moments across a video library with semantic or text search.

skills.name: Video Chat
skills.description: Answers questions about one or more uploaded videos.

skills.name: Clip Generation
skills.description: Generates short highlight clips from longer videos.

skills.name: Vision MCP Server
skills.description: Lets MCP clients upload, index, search and question videos through the reka-mcp server.
